glossaries.name: Commerce
glossaries.description: Shared business language for the digital media commerce use case.

glossaryTerms.name: Customer
glossaryTerms.description: A person or organization with an account that can purchase digital products.

glossaryTerms.name: CustomerIdentifier
glossaryTerms.description: A stable key used to distinguish one customer account from another.

glossaryTerms.name: DigitalProduct
glossaryTerms.description: A purchasable digital media item represented by a track in the source catalog.

glossaryTerms.name: Order
glossaryTerms.description: A completed commerce transaction represented by an invoice and its line items.

glossaryTerms.name: Revenue
glossaryTerms.description: Realized line amount calculated as sold quantity multiplied by unit price.

glossaryTerms.name: AverageOrderValue
glossaryTerms.description: Total realized revenue divided by the number of distinct orders.

glossaryTerms.name: CustomerLifetimeValue
glossaryTerms.description: Cumulative realized revenue attributed to a customer across the observed history.

dataProducts.name: CommerceInsights
dataProducts.description: Curated customer, sales, catalog, and executive KPI assets for analytics and AI consumers.
